decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. TXN-007902 (19.62 EUR at OAKHOLLOW CHEMIST, MER-000049) posted on 2026-07-19, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, 95 days later. The limit is 120 days. Its authorisation, AUTH-008111, was approved with entry mode CHIP and the PIN verified. 3-D Secure did not apply and the fraud flag was not set. Under the chip-and-PIN rule, the card and PIN were both present, so the payment counts as made by the cardholder. The card's history supports this: it shows four approved purchases at the same merchant before the disputed one (TXN-005247, TXN-007900, TXN-005251, TXN-007901) and one after it (TXN-005249). The cardholder says they do not recognise the payment and that the card never left them, but the records do not support an unauthorised transaction.

proposed_actions.reason: The payment of 19.62 EUR at OAKHOLLOW CHEMIST on 2026-07-18 was made in person with your card's chip and the correct PIN, with no sign of fraud. A payment made this way is treated as made by the cardholder. Your card also shows several other purchases at this merchant before and after this payment.
